title: Emergent abilities under continued pretraining
description: We studied how the mix of languages in continued pretraining affects in-context learning after adapting a model to a new language.

title: WiCkeD makes multiple-choice benchmarks harder
description: We tested what happens when benchmarks replace an answer choice with “None of the above,” making it harder for language models to answer correctly.

title: Improving factuality in clinical summaries
description: We used guided continued pretraining to improve the factual accuracy of summaries drawn from multiple clinical documents.
